# MetaViewer
Rust authority; Electron/Vue renders admitted snapshots and submits intents.
Read first: AGENTS.md, then catalogue/protocol.json.
Release authority: VERSION; pending changes: changes/unreleased/.

Task preparation: Create automation, Run automation, and Direct task end with "Task: ". Unpaired prompts copy to clipboard. Paired controls offer installed, host-owned agent CLI profiles; after a recognized input prompt, they paste with bracketed paste and never send Enter. Missing, exited, unready or authentication-waiting agents receive no prompt. Plain shells remain copy-only. These controls prepare text; they do not execute workflows. See docs/AGENT_ENTRY.md.

Current shell: three columns [CITED: ui/src/App.vue], left Humans/Agents tree with desktops and capsules, center wall, paired terminal dock and capsule drawer. Dark is the default for new settings. Compact grid presets retain full tooltips; Custom grid sets snapping rows/columns, and floating placement uses the next free cell where possible. Storyboard is not available in live navigation.
Identities: Stored data manages slots containing saved data and signed-in sessions, not open tabs; stop the capsule and close login first. Release verifies a previous-session hold, retains saved browser data and refuses live or unverified ownership. The launcher lists installed host apps without isolation. Settings has a Recording card for rate, folders and RAM/disk-on-stop mode. Agent launch uses terminal profiles or Custom CLI then Launch; pairing alone opens a host shell.
ARM64 VM, MicroVM and rewind need developer setup with verified local assets, arm64 only; no judge install is promised. x64 VM and MicroVM are not in this release. Windows 10 WSL has no nested KVM. wender-agent, vision-engine and OpenSuperficies remain fully private. See docs/USER_GUIDE.md and docs/ARM64_CAPSULE_SETUP.md.
